instruction: Switch off Chrome's Safe Browsing feature to prevent security warnings for sites and downloads.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks users to disable Safe Browsing in Chrome security settings (opposite of variation 0). Similar difficulty to Do Not Track task - requires navigating to Chrome Security settings and turning off Safe Browsing. The evaluator checks that both 'safebrowsing.enabled' and 'safebrowsing.enhanced' fields are false. This tests the opposite action (disabling instead of enabling) with same complexity level.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts Safe Browsing state from Chrome Preferences file
Getter correctly checks both 'safebrowsing.enabled' and 'safebrowsing.enhanced' fields, returning 'false' only when both are disabled
Metric function 'exact_match' correctly compares getter result against expected value
Expected value 'false' is semantically correct - it represents Safe Browsing being completely turned off
Data flow is correct: getter returns 'false'/'true' string -> get_rule extracts rules dict -> exact_match compares result against rules['expected']
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk before evaluation
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies that Safe Browsing is fully disabled (both standard and enhanced modes off)
Edge case handling: getter defaults to 'true' on error, ensuring safe failure mode
